items.q: Which statement correctly defines Naturalistic observation?

a ceremony that marks a young person's formal admission to adult status
the distress a baby shows when an unfamiliar person approaches

items.s: Naturalistic observation: the recording of behaviour as it occurs in its ordinary setting without interference. The other options describe Imaginary audience, Stranger anxiety, Rite of passage.

items.s: Scaffolding: the temporary support an adult gives so that a child can complete a task just beyond reach. The other options describe Heteronomous morality, Menopause, Early adulthood.

items.s: Rite of passage: a ceremony that marks a young person's formal admission to adult status. The other options describe Menarche, Cross-sectional design, Temperament.

items.s: Puberty: the period in which the reproductive organs mature and adult body features appear. The other options describe Embryo, Foetus, Temperament.
